newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Apr 1st 20 days trade surplus 352.67 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan Apr 1st 20 days trade surplus 352.67 bln yen.

text.p: Japan posted a customs-cleared trade surplus of 352.67 billion yen in the first 20 days of April, compared with a deficit of 59.06 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports in the period rose 19.9 percent from a year earlier to 2.81 trillion yen, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports increased 2.3 percent to 2.46 trillion yen.
